what: On hover, a wide ellipse waiting outside below the button (305%) rises in .6s to just below center (145%) while widening 115% → 300% to fill the button, and the text color changes in .18s — the rise uses cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), the spread width uses cubic-bezier(.9,0,1,1) (spreads sharply at the end). On release both sink in .5s with .16,1,.3,1. For glass pill buttons and enter buttons.

options.--fx-wave-fg: Text color after filling, default var(--kf-bg)

note: Moves the gradient position with a registered variable (@property) — older browsers that can’t use registered variables switch immediately
